newsitem.title: USA: MGE spring wheat closes lower, bear spreads noted.
newsitem.headline: MGE spring wheat closes lower, bear spreads noted.

text.p: MGE spring wheat futures closed lower in step with a fund and local-related selloff in CBOT wheat, traders said.
Cash-connected bear spreading was noted with the December/March closing at 13-1/2 to 14 cents, a one cent loss for the December relative to the March.

Peavey Co sold 700,000 bushels of March, Benson Quinn sold 500,000 December and Continental Grain bought 600,000 December, traders said. Cargill Inc bought 500,000 MGE March against Chicago, they said.
MGE spring wheat futures closed one to 4-1/4 cents per bushel lower, with December down 4-1/4 at $4.17-3/4.
